paragraphs.text:
The horror that was Charlie shudders. Her torn lips move as 
if forced to speak against her will. “If you would know what the 
Ten`a-ranide know, go where the Ten`a-ranide go! Speak the word 
that protects! Hallapjora-syojatar.’’

With that strange utterance, Charlie’s mangled corpse falls 
over and lies inert. All is still within the formation of stones.

To hurry from the megalithic site, go to 442. To go into the temple of 
the wheel formation, saying, “Hallapjora-syojatar,” go to 450.
